purpose: Centralize the non-fish formal content inputs that still block DeliveryHarnessAssets, without splitting presentation, unlocks, imprint admission, growth Buffs, fatigue presentation, or yellow-stamina presentation into separately closable tasks.

gap_list.available_fact: The human progress entry records DataWorldProfileAlbum and CharacterGrowthCondition as engineering-complete but not formally content-complete, and keeps DeliveryHarnessAssets blocked by formal presentation and progress/growth content decisions.

technical_plan.available_fact: The technical plan records the same product/content boundaries: unlock milestones, imprint admission, Buff choices, fatigue presentation, yellow-stamina boundaries, and player-visible presentation resources remain open inputs rather than engineering facts.

release_handoff.available_fact: DeliveryReleaseHandoffPackage already carries FormalPresentationBoundaryFreeze and FormalProgressGrowthContentFreeze as remaining input contracts under one DeliveryHarnessAssets release surface.

harness_contract.available_fact: DeliveryHarnessAssets is a single atomic module; formal presentation and progress/growth content blockers must remain module-level Delivery inputs instead of scattered subtasks.

required_facts: Formal UI or presentation resources for any player-visible Lake status, menu, fish, bite, fight, and asset naming paths.
A product decision that native debug text, raw state labels, and test asset names are not visible on the formal player path.
A confirmation path for reopening any default-hidden native LakeReach debug surface only after it is replaced by formal presentation.
do_not_do: Do not reopen UIReach or FrontendOnline as partial presentation tasks.
Do not treat the default-hidden CatLakeReachWidget debug path as formal player UI readiness.
Do not mark DeliveryHarnessAssets complete from Static inventory while formal presentation is still open.

required_facts: Concrete world, growth, or album milestones that produce each formal equipment UnlockId.
Full imprint admission list beyond TheftCaught, including which run events can create permanent Imprint grants.
Formal growth Buff choices, numeric effects, and player-facing copy for PendingChoiceCount consumption.
Formal light, medium, and heavy fatigue presentation triggers now that fatigue is no longer a gameplay number.
Formal yellow-stamina shield presentation and consumption boundary.
do_not_do: Do not mark DataWorldProfileAlbum formally complete from engineering Profile or Collection automation alone.
Do not mark CharacterGrowthCondition formally complete from ASC and Growth automation while Buff, fatigue, or yellow-stamina content is still open.
Do not split UnlockId, imprint admission, Buff, fatigue, and yellow-stamina decisions into separate DeliveryHarnessAssets subtasks.

close_rule: This package can move to ready only when both content_groups are satisfied with authoritative product/content facts and package_blocking_gaps is empty. It does not close DeliveryHarnessAssets by itself; Delivery still also requires formal fish asset readiness, tracked test asset replacement, RunEnvironmentSocial module behavior evidence, and passing Static plus AssetReadiness verification.
